title: Cardinal Billing Account Renewal Down Payment: Computation of the Amount
content:
**Computation clause.** On a Cardinal Billing Account, the renewal down payment is installment 1 of the renewal term, invoiced on the renewal bill date and due on the renewal term's first day. The renewal down payment is the renewal down payment percentage, which is the pay plan's down payment percentage, of the renewal full-term premium, which is the term premium received most recently on the account; that product is rounded to the cent, raised to the pay plan's minimum down payment when it falls below it, and lowered to the renewal full-term premium when it would exceed it. The renewal down payment is stated to the cent.

## Inputs

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Renewal full-term premium | The term premium entry received most recently on the account's billing history |
| Renewal down payment percentage | The pay plan's down payment percentage |
| Minimum down payment | The pay plan's minimum down payment |
| Bill date | The renewal bill date, the day the invoice is issued |

## Order of the computation

1. The percentage is applied to the renewal full-term premium and the product is rounded to the cent.
2. The rounded figure is raised to the minimum down payment when it falls below it.
3. It is lowered to the renewal full-term premium when it would exceed it.

## Worked figures (hypothetical plan figures)

| Renewal full-term premium | Plan percentage | Plan minimum | Product, rounded | Renewal down payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| $1,250.00 | 20 percent | $60.00 | $250.00 | $250.00 |
| $250.00 | 16.67 percent | $60.00 | $41.68 | $60.00, raised to the minimum |
| $45.00 | 20 percent | $60.00 | $9.00 | $45.00, the minimum would exceed the premium, so it is lowered to the premium |
